heatmap_point_audit.purpose: Current decoder selects largest thresholded box, but reports global peak confidence. Inspect whether those refer to the same region on actual frames.

reproduction_note: Experiment scripts refuse overwrite. Keep local ignored artifacts; use a fresh output location to rerun. Maintained check_trajectory.py can reproduce D1 baseline from frozen manifest and cache.
score_only_fix_note: For unchanged positions and default confidence=0.6, using the selected >0.6 component maximum does not change validity or segmentation. Uniform 360-frame audit also observed zero validity changes at this threshold. Higher confidence thresholds or selecting different positions need separate evaluation.
